capabilities: Show a Today page with draggable cards for weather, tasks, habits, mood, calendar and notes
Plan tasks onto a day, week or month board by dragging, setting due or planned dates
Manage projects and areas as lists or status boards with an inbox for unplaced tasks
Replace the file explorer with a sidebar that has search, folder groups and drag-to-move
Read tasks from checkboxes, TaskNotes-format notes, Todoist, ClickUp or Things 3
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README details exactly which network requests each optional feature makes and states there is no account, payment or tracking.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in day or week planning surface, project boards, or a way to schedule and review tasks across notes.

relations.evidence: If the TaskNotes plugin is installed, you can let it do the writing instead.
Checkboxes in any note, including the Tasks plugin's date and priority signs.
Todoist or ClickUp, with your own API token.
LifeWorld reads and updates your Things to-dos by running Things' own AppleScript

requires.name: Todoist, ClickUp or Stormglass API token

summary: Planner suite that adds a Today page, a day/week/month Planner board, projects and areas, and a sidebar, working on plain Markdown task notes.
